data.narrative:
Ouros Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $3M+ to date. The valuation universe includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in Climate & Energy, including later-stage companies such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and provides the primary valuation signal. Using total capital raised of $3M as a proxy for Seed-stage value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $8M. A peer-median approach is not applicable; while eight same-sector comparables exist, none satisfy the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier valuation peers. Narrowing the comp set to three or more datapoints within these constraints yielded zero results, making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The triangulation analysis supports a range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median of $8M. This range is derived from a single applicable method, creating material uncertainty around absolute value. Key risks to valuation include the narrow methodological foundation, the absence of direct Seed-stage peers for benchmarking, and general early-stage execution risk. The low end assumes conservative step-up assumptions; the high end reflects optionality typical of frontier-tech venture rounds. Validation would benefit from additional Seed-stage comparables or clarification of capital deployment milestones.
